description: spec-tests-harness.md's role-rename finding, reproduced: a routing.log can legitimately hold an `event=backlog` record carrying a NEW role name (`builder`, free text — backlog.py validates only the identifier charset, never a closed RoleId enum) sitting right next to an `event=dispatch` record carrying an OLD role name (`fixer`, the closed dispatch-path vocabulary). Both `backlog list` and `tasks --no-reconcile` must read the mixed file without erroring or special-casing either vocabulary — a Rust reader that validated `role=` as a closed enum on every record kind would reject the live fleet's own history the moment it tried this.
